They seem to make the place bigger but yet you can still never get an appointment. You have to explain to the receptionist what your problem is before they think they can give you an appointment or not. You explain your problem then they are like sorry all appointments are gone for today call back tomorrow is what you get. Bearing in mind I get in the queue as soon as the surgery opens at 8am. How can all appointments be gone by 8:20am. Don't even bother with the econsult took them 5days to get back to me. After asking lots of questions that shouldn't apply like..... Do I gamble?!?! What the hell? I just read a news article the other day about a PRIVATE doctors surgery opening in Canterbury with appointments going from £150. I have to wonder if they will make hawkinge private. Coz something really isn't right. Or maybe it's just horrendous management.
